components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; width: 240px; padding: 10px; background: #f9fbf7; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(11 26 46 / 0.08), 0 4px 12px -4px rgb(11 26 46 / 0.12); } .ds-rings { position: relative; width: 60px; height: 60px; } .ds-rings b { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; color: #0b1a2e; } .ds-total { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-meta { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: #3d4a5a; } .ds-late { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #c4321c; }

narrative.overview: Monset's website draws the company's two peaks as a contour survey: night-navy ground, drafting film, orange contour ink. The POS carries that world onto a working counter screen and takes only what a tool can afford from it: the palette, Archivo with its expanded survey lettering, calm density, and one signature move. Navy is the structure, drafting film is where work happens, orange is the one thing to do next (or what is chosen), and red is held back for trouble.
keyCharacteristics: Night-navy shell, drafting-film work surface, paper cards.
Contour orange for the primary action and for selection; pin red only for late, void and error, always with words.
Archivo Variable throughout; expanded tracked caps for survey labels; tabular figures for all money.
Near-square 4px corners, hairline dividers, soft lift only on cards and the drawer.
Signature: contour age rings around each table's name.

rules.name: The One Next Thing Rule
rules.body: At most one filled Contour Orange button per screen: the action most likely needed next.

rules.name: The Words-With-Red Rule
rules.body: Pin Red never appears without a word saying what is wrong.

rules.name: The Orange Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: A chosen option is Contour Wash with a 2px inset Contour Deep keyline. Navy fills are for actions, never selection.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every peso figure is tabular and right-aligned in lists.

rules.name: The Monospace Is a Receipt Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where the UI shows a document exactly as printed and journaled.

rules.name: The Two Lifts Rule
rules.body: Only cards and the drawer cast shadows; everything else separates by tone or hairline.

dos: Do keep one filled Contour Orange action per screen, bottom right of the drawer.
Do use tabular, right-aligned figures for every amount.
Do keep all four stage lanes visible whenever the drawer is open.
Do pair Pin Red with words, every time.
Do give touch targets 48px+ and payment actions 56px.
Do keep order entry instant: no animation on adding items, scanning or keypads.
donts: Don't use orange as text on film; use Contour Deep (#a65410).
Don't fill a selected option with navy.
Don't put an uppercase label above a heading as an eyebrow.
Don't use monospace anywhere except a printed-document preview.
Don't add shadows beyond the Card and Drawer lifts.
Don't let toasts cover a receipt or document; they sit bottom-left of the work area and clear on navigation.
